# P05 reader-feature fixtures

The [IsOS owner contract](../../../docs/isos/interfaces/reader-features.md) defines the target behavior. `cases.json` freezes 36 implementation cases. Each case has a stable `id`, operation, named mutation and an `expected` result. Rejection cases require the exact code, stage, graph JSON Pointer, selected binary ID, requested feature when applicable, unchanged saved bytes and zero stop/spawn calls. Restart failures additionally assert unchanged active child PIDs. The baseline graph is the existing `0.1.0` edge fixture; implementations construct the named target starter, MuJoCo and legacy variants from their registered owner catalogs. The fixture file is declarative design evidence, not a claim that P05 runtime behavior already passes.

Positive cases cover an exact EOS starter, safe scalar-only legacy read, a graph-independent HTTP bridge, EGIA's registered legacy IDs inside a `0.1.0` envelope, and a verified MuJoCo package contribution loaded through `--node-types`, and a legacy MuJoCo child with the runtime feature. Negatives cover G01/G03 precedence, known graph and registered type omission from selected arrays, malformed/partial array fallback, conditional features including an enabled bridge without Vision and a legacy backend child, exact process path and binary identity, package pin and receipt changes, and selected binary changes after Apply. A target feature missing on the exact selected child cannot be cleared by probing a sibling binary. The upgrade cases require exact verified release evidence and prohibit an install or selection side effect from `version check`.

Implementations should use a fresh `ISOS_HOME`, stub selected setup/runtime probes with fixed hashes, and a verified `island/mujoco-sim@0.1.1` sidecar for package cases. For Run/Restart rejection, begin with a live EOS-only deployment and assert the active revision and PID set are unchanged. Test both `isos version check --json` and HTTP/CLI admission surfaces. Keep full outputs under ignored `logs/test/<run-id>/`; use the commands and expected assertions in the owner contract before closing P05. Validate the fixture with `python3 tests/fixtures/reader_features/check_cases.py`.
